# alodash

> Promise-enabled lodash functions

A tiny proxy that wraps lodash functions to work seamlessly with promises. Add an 'a' prefix to any lodash function to use it with async values.

## What it does
- Promise-enables all lodash functions via ES6 Proxy
- Parameters can be values, promises, or functions
- Zero config, works with existing lodash knowledge

## Install
```bash
npm install alodash
```

## Quick Start
```javascript
const { aget } = require('alodash');

const promise = Promise.resolve({some:{deeply:{nested:{prop:1}}}});
const value = await aget(promise, 'some.deeply.nested.prop');
console.log(value);  // 1
```
